observations: Installed beside an earlier test build, 1.0.0.1 keeps to its own folders, registry entries and menu entries, but both would start at sign-in on Windows, and uninstalling the earlier build afterwards removes the Start menu shortcuts (Windows) and the menu icons (Bazzite) that both use; running the 1.0.0.1 installer again puts them back. Hence the release notes: remove earlier test builds first.
A silent Windows uninstall (Uninstall.exe /S) waits for its confirmation box, as in earlier versions.
The real Windows update step cannot run under Wine 9.0 (CopyFile2); it needs Windows.
The full Python suite peaks at about 4 GB in one process; run alone it passes.
